name: ads-mcp-for-snapchat
description: Snapchat Ads reports, audits and safe, previewed changes to campaigns, ad squads and ads.
long_description: Unofficial. Runs on your computer with your own Snapchat OAuth app. Every change is previewed and needs your approval; money limits, a change log and undo are built in. After installing, ask Claude: "connect my Snapchat ad account". With the shared login you only log in with Snapchat; no OAuth app is needed.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: Only if you use your own Snapchat OAuth app (Business Details > OAuth Apps, Redirect URI https://127.0.0.1/callback). Leave empty to use the shared login.

client_secret.title: Client Secret
client_secret.description: Only with your own OAuth app. Shown once when you create it. Stored by Claude Desktop, never sent to the chat. Leave empty to use the shared login.

max_daily_budget.title: Highest daily budget
max_daily_budget.description: The highest daily budget Claude may set, in your account's currency.

default_country.title: Main country (optional)
default_country.description: Two letters, such as us, sa or ae. Used when a new ad squad does not name its countries.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: On: Claude can read and preview but change nothing. Turn it off when you are ready.
